biography: Riku occupies a quiet and unassuming corner in the storied chronicles of the Hector Trophée, having made a singular, carefully deliberated appearance in the esteemed pair competition representing the manicured fairways of Koto Golf. Sharing a familiar bond as the brother of Panu, this reserved competitor brings an air of quiet determination to the fairways, approaching every round with a deeply introspective mindset that keeps his playing partners guessing about his next strategic move.

Although Riku has officially concluded his active chapters within the tournament and is now considered retired from further Hector engagements, his legacy remains untouched by major silverware. Victories of the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual acclaim of the Victor Trophy ultimately remained outside his personal collection across his lone tournament appearance, yet his dignified presence left a lasting impression on those fortunate enough to share the course with him.
